correctness.rationale: For a finite poset P, ideals J(P) encode all finite distributive lattices. Adjoining one maximal point with any downset of predecessors, and exact directed graph isomorphism deduplication, exhaust all posets of sizes 0..7 (counts 1,1,2,5,16,63,318,2045). Two-variable no-counting unary Hintikka sets T_{t+1}(a)={(ρ(a,b),T_t(b)):b∈J(P)} with root supports U_t capture FO² sentence rank t+1. The fully rerun independent census computed 2451 distinct lattices; rank 1..6 class counts 1,5,78,789,2449,2451, including exactly two rank-five exceptional pairs of sizes 34/32 and 16/14. Independent explicit witness refinement agrees through rank five and separates at six. Finite exhaustiveness proves the stated restricted universal bound; makes no claim beyond seven irreducibles.
residual_risks: Enumeration correctness depends on graph-isomorphism deduplication and exact implementation, audited with an independent full replay; the theorem covers only |Jirr|≤7 and ordinary FO² pure order without counting.
